items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...And maybe Chitty and Ralph can help out.

ctx.x: What do you think people have that ready for me?
Well when he finishes it, I'll make him do all the work. I'll see what I can do. And maybe Chitty and Ralph can help out. We can all pitch in.
From what you heard, what did you think of the album? Just bring this. Okay.
